news.text: LUCIO, A BITTER #JUVE#Spalletti's frankness: "Here, I am risking the end of my career"High tension after the disappointing draw in #Cagliari, he does not accept the many points thrown away: "We must all be up to the task. It's not just the result of a single match at stake, I am almost 70 years old". Celta on Thursday: in #Gatti, #Koop, #Alajbegović and #Woltemade.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE PROMISES A TRUE NUMBER 9 TO LUCIO#Kolo needs a a striking partner: as early as JanuaryIt is not working with #Woltemade, #Ekhator is still KO, he has practically never been seen and regardless, he seems more like a second striker: an intervention in attack is urgent. #Alajbegović is warming up ahead of Vigo.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🚨 Fracture of the right fibula for Loïs #Openda: sidelined at least until the next international break.#Lyon attacks the referees: «The player did not receive the necessary protection». They contested the numerous fouls suffered from #Lens, which were punished with only a single booking.[IlBianconero]

Touched on Friday evening during the match against RC Lens, Loïs Openda will be unavailable for at least the next international break.OL regrets the treatment reserved for its striker and the shock that forces him to stay away from the field.Courage Loïs, we're with you ❤️💙💪[Olympique Lyonnais]

ℹ️😡 The argument between #Spalletti and #Pisacane stemmed from tension accumulated throughout the entire match, fueled by #Mina's provocations and time-wasting. During the handshake between the managers, the rossoblù coach touched the arm of the bianconero coach. The two confronted each other verbally and the latter threatened: "I will slap you". Marcenaro consequently gave a red card to both.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

💪 After the draw against #Cagliari, #Spalletti granted his players a day off to recover from the match. The bianconeri will return to training at la Continassa tomorrow to prepare for the Europa League clash away against #CeltaVigo.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 DAZN's lip-reading analysis reconstructed the face-to-face confrontation between Luciano #Spalletti and Fabio #Pisacane at the final whistle of #CagliariJuventus.The #Juventus coach approached the Sardinian manager and snapped: "You're also good at wasting time."The provocation triggered an immediate reaction from #Pisacane and the situation escalated further when #Spalletti insisted with a "What are you doing?"His colleague fired back: "No, what are you doing?" And the Tuscan coach wrapped up with a warning: "I'll slap you!"The intervention of #Cagliari's assistant coach prevented physical contact, but the referee handed a red card to both. 📊 The equalizer goal for the 1-1 in #CagliariJuventus was Randal #KoloMuani's first in Serie A 2026/2027, after five matchdays without scoring.The French striker hadn't scored in a domestic league since last February, back when he was wearing the #Tottenham shirt.He has already scored for #Juventus against #NEC in the Europa League, but his drought in the local tournament was still ongoing.[@TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]

✅ The feedback gathered by #Juventus on Alessandro #Romano is very positive. The midfielder has made an excellent impression and will be one of the players the bianconero management will focus on in the coming months. #Cagliari, which must first buy him outright from #Roma, values him at 20+mln.[Mirko Di Natale]

The stat on the 14th game without a comeback after falling behind (out of 16 under #Spalletti's management) is worrying and gives cause for reflection. The mental strength is one of those components that lead you to victory. Big clubs are made of these details, #Juve is not there yet.[Mirko Di Natale]

📊 #Juventus finished the #CagliariJuventus match 1-1 with 23 goal attempts, 2.3 expected goals (xG) and 72% ball possession.The 23 attempts are total chances created, not shots on target.Expected goals measure the quality of the chances created and do not guarantee a result, but #Juve scored 1.3 goals fewer than the value of the chances they generated.Nico #González missed a good chance in the first half and in the second half #Zhegrova tested #Caprile with his shots.The equalizer came in the 80th minute: #Alajbegović found #KoloMuani, who anticipated the defender and scored the 1-1. Towards the end, #KoloMuani hit the crossbar and came close to scoring a brace.[@TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]

Lucio-#Pisacane, Quite A Brawl#Juve, high tension: 1-1 comeback in #Cagliari#Maldini freezes #Vicario. #Alajbegović wakes the bianconeri up: assist for #Kolo's goal, who then also hits the crossbar. Electric final: both managers sent off. #Milan draws with #Sassuolo (1-1).[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE, 22 SHOTS FOR ONE #KOLO#Maldini (4th goal in a row!) puts #Cagliari ahead, followed by a frantic and sterile siege: but only a header from the Frenchman finds the net. #Spalletti-#Pisacane final brawl: both sent off.The bianconeri, also denied by the crossbar, waste incredible opportunities: #Woltemade comes on and makes a mess. #Muani: "It's absurd not to take three points". #Spalletti: "I'm a bit angry because these are matches we have to win. But a great performance: if we play like this, we will win many... #Pisacane? I only told him that they are also good at wasting time". [Front Page TuttoSport]

🎙Randal #KoloMuani to @DAZN_IT:FEELINGS"I'm a bit nervous about how this match turned out, because we had the chances and, based on how the game went and the opportunities we had, we should have gone home with all three points."SECONDS HALF"At halftime, the manager told us to increase the number of crosses and, with the introduction of #Woltemade, it became easier for me.We created a lot."MORE SPACE WITH #WOLTEMADE "With him on the pitch, the opponents have one more thing to worry about and I have more freedom"HOW DO I FEEL?"It's not easy for a striker when the goals aren't coming, but I have always felt everyone's trust.Work and keep going forward."[@PuebloJ]
